title: ability.requested
description: server → host. Asks the host to apply a simulation ability (every role except FLIGHT). The host must answer ability.resolve within 5 s; no answer, or a host disconnect before the answer, counts as declined with reason NOT_APPLICABLE.

role.description: Role whose ability is requested (never FLIGHT).

stageIndex.description: STRUCT: stage to reinforce; null for other roles.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RequestId.description: Ability request identifier chosen by the server; unique within the room.

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.
